Choices:
A. [MARKED CORRECT] avions fourni
B. fournissions
C. avons fourni
D. aurions fourni

3. Option D (aurions fourni) is conditional, which doesn't fit the context
4. While option C (avons fourni) is grammatically possible, the plus-que-parfait more clearly expresses the temporal relationship
